title: From Brazil's World Cup hero to Lil Wayne in four photos
description: Four real photos link 2002 World Cup winner Rivaldo to Lil Wayne, through Ronaldinho and two presidents.
hook: How is Rivaldo connected to Lil Wayne?

links.line: In 2002, Rivaldo lined up with Ronaldinho in Brazil's team photo, and together they won the World Cup.

image.file: File:2019 Encontro com Presidente do Instituto Brasileiro do Turismo, Gilson Machado e o ex-jogador de futebol, Ronaldinho Gaúcho.jpg

links.line: In June 2019, Ronaldinho visited Brazil's president Jair Bolsonaro in Brasília to talk about promoting tourism.

image.file: File:Bolsonaro with US President Donald Trump in White House, 19 March 2019.jpg

links.line: Earlier that year at the White House, Bolsonaro and Donald Trump swapped personalized football jerseys.
And in October 2020, days before the election, Trump met Lil Wayne in Florida for this thumbs-up photo.
